checkpoint: backdrop-masked rounded corners and animated live neighbor insertion
source_digest_scope: Sorted names + NUL + bytes + NUL: src, benches, examples, tests, assets, tools excluding pycache; Cargo/build/toolchain/format/lint/Make/launcher/gitignore. Portable Cargo.lock bytes.

environment.build: release, thin LTO, one codegen unit
environment.sources: 41 temporary cached upstream source substitutions; unchanged 266-package graph; portable lockfile restored afterward
environment.renderer: Ratatui TestBackend; shared host, scheduling and caches uncontrolled

workloads.capture: 40 actual MouseDown + interactive frames per process; held and visible neighbor captures bounded to 20000 cells each and 40000 cells in total
workloads.held: 200 actual diagonal drag + interactive frames per process; exact x/y, dimmed background, all captured corners and every visible moved corner checked
workloads.settling: 400 injected-time tick + interactive frames per process; immediate saved order and completion checked
workloads.neighbor_insertion: 400 controlled-time neighbor ticks + real frames across 40 gestures per process; final neighbor x and unchanged durable order checked

limitations: New compositor draws captured neighbors and masks corner backgrounds; fresh measurements with no before/after speedup claim.
Frames measure composition work, excluding physical terminal transport/paint and the 16 ms animation polling interval.
Whole-process wall time and peak RSS include setup; RSS does not measure allocations.
Physical Alacritty and clean-registry qualification remain unavailable.
